title: Choose the visual world for VroomDealer
question: The roll assigned The Mechanic's Diagnostic Tablet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Diagnostic Tablet
options.thesis: The pragmatic, industrial tool that reads the true value of a car.
options.viewport: A 'scan' of the entered car model, displaying real-time calculations and local dealer matches as a diagnostic readout.
options.risk: Might feel too technical or 'garage-like' for a casual private seller.

raised.raise: The valuation numbers ignite as seven-segment digits rather than standard fonts.

options.label: The Valuation Certificate
options.lineage: official paperwork and vehicle history reports
options.thesis: A document of truth, making the offer feel guaranteed and legally sound.
options.viewport: A clean, white 'document' being stamped with the final guaranteed cash offer.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on.

options.label: The Live Ticker
options.lineage: financial ticker tape and trading floors
options.thesis: The marketplace where dealers bid in real-time.
options.viewport: A dark dashboard with flashing 'recent sales' and live 'bids' for similar cars.
options.case: Fuses well with the idea of 'best price in 24h'; introduces strong urgency.
options.risk: Can feel like a stock trading app rather than a simple car sale.

options.label: The Seven-Segment Readout
options.lineage: gas station price totems and digital clocks
options.thesis: Unapologetic, giant numbers delivering the final price.
options.viewport: A towering set of glowing red numbers calculating the offer.
options.case: Fuses perfectly with 'instant cash offer'. Very automotive.
options.risk: Might lack the space for detailed explanations and trust-building copy.

options.label: The Strip Sign
options.case: Too Vegas/flashy. 'Skup aut' has a bad reputation that we want to avoid, not amplify.
options.kept: A focus on hard-edged, bold typography for the primary call to action.

canonCard.label: The Modern SaaS Marketplace
canonCard.thesis: The category standard for modern B2B/B2C tech startups.
canonCard.viewport: A clean hero section with a centered lead form over a blurred gradient background.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other generic 'AI' tools or tech startups (the 'AI slop' the user explicitly rejected).
